title: Ordinary quotient association and its strict transition adjunct
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E→L and a scheme W. Let P be any cochain complex over the completed E-coefficient ring sheaf, with no flatness or boundedness requirement. Let X be a complex of actual L-coefficient sequences [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], and let e_n identify its ordinary nth evaluated complex with the ordinary finite scalar tensor of P [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-well-defined]. Assume the actual successor transitions conjugate through e to the specified quotient tensor transitions. Fix n≤m and an ordinary adjunction of the recorded quotient extension [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] with actual scalar restriction, whose unit sends x to the sheafified 1 tensor x. Then there is an ordinary chain isomorphism a from B_n tensor_(B_m) ev_m(X) to ev_n(X) whose composite after the ordinary adjunction unit and restriction is exactly the actual m-to-n chain transition. This statement does not concern localization or derived normalization.

proof.text: Use the normalized ordinary sheaf scalar-extension adjunction for each rho_n. The coefficient quotient commutes with rho for every n <= m, by induction from the known successor formula and quotient functoriality. Identify successive restriction with restriction along rho_n sectionwise, using restrictScalarsComp′App. Compose the rho_m adjunction with the supplied quotient adjunction and use leftAdjointUniq to obtain the ordinary natural associator. Its unit equation sends the image of the rho_m unit under the quotient unit to the rho_n unit.

Use the actual abelian section transition maps and their proved identity/composition equations. Apply the successor HEq hypothesis to the inverse evaluation image of 1 tensor x, cancel the evaluation isomorphism, and use the specified integralScalarTransition formula. Induct on n <= m to obtain the corresponding tensor-unit equality for all actual transitions. These ordinary identities are the section calculations already proved for the sequence Roos model.

Map the ordinary associator to complexes and conjugate it with e_m and e_n. To prove its restricted composite with the quotient unit is the actual transition, precompose with e_m inverse and apply the injective rho_m adjunction Hom equivalence. In every degree and on each section, naturality of the quotient unit and the associator unit equation reduce the left side to e_n inverse of 1 tensor x, and the preceding induction gives exactly the right side. The supplied hunit is unnecessary for this existential statement since the associator is constructed from the supplied adjunction.

theorem coefficientExtensionOrdinaryQuotientIso
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (adj : coefficientFiniteQuotientExtension l L W h ⊣ normalizedDVRModuleRes l L W h)
    (hunit : ∀ (M : normalizedDVRModules l L W m) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj U),
      coefficientRestrictionSection (normalizedDVRQuotient l L W h)
        ((coefficientFiniteQuotientExtension l L W h).obj M) U
        (((adj.unit.app M).val.app U) x) = coefficientFiniteQuotientUnitSection l L W h M U x)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E W) ℤ)
    (X : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l L W) ℤ)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X ≅
        (integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι W n).obj P)
    (htransition : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W (n + 1)).obj (X.X i)).val.obj U)),
      HEq ((((coefficientSequenceTransition l L W (Nat.le_succ n)).app
          (X.X i)).val.app U).hom x)
        (((((e n).inv).f i).val.app U).hom
          ((((integralScalarTransition l E L ι W n).app P).f i).val.app U
            ((((e (n + 1)).hom).f i).val.app U x))))
    : ∃ a : ((coefficientFiniteQuotientExtension l L W h).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X) ≅
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X,
      (adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app
          (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l L W m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X) ≫
        ((normalizedDVRModuleRes l L W h).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map a.hom =
      (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (coefficientSequenceTransition l L W h)
        (.up ℤ)).app X
